chapter: Rhythm Club, studio dates and the 1930s big bands
title: Brooklyn work, Austin Powell and Louis Jordan, and the Club Sudan
summary: Questions about Brooklyn lead to McRae's 1945 Town Hill job, Austin Powell's return and his rock-and-roll writing.
